![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Avoid using `Intl.Collator` with an `undefined` locale for sorting, as it can introduce locale-sensitive discrepancies across different runtime environments. Instead, use a strict lexicographical byte-order comparison to ensure locale-independent, deterministic ordering.

```suggestion
// Removed NATURAL_COLLATOR to avoid locale-sensitive discrepancies
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Avoid using Intl.Collator with an undefined locale for sorting, as it can introduce locale-sensitive discrepancies across different runtime environments. Instead, use a strict lexicographical byte-order comparison to ensure locale-independent, deterministic ordering.
</details>

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

For validator scripts, aggregate all input-related errors (such as missing, parse, input-shape, or read errors) into a single validation check (e.g., `input_artifacts_valid`) to ensure the validator fails closed deterministically, and sort the emitted checks lexicographically by their identifier/code to prevent diff churn.

```javascript
    check(
      'input_artifacts_valid',
      (missingSourceArtifacts.length === 0 && asArray(contract.input_diagnostics).length === 0) ? 'pass' : 'fail',
      'Required input artifacts are present and no critical input diagnostics were recorded.',
      {
        missing_paths: missingSourceArtifacts,
        input_diagnostics: contract.input_diagnostics || [],
      },
    ),
```

body: Fixed in 3eec58395: removed the NATURAL_COLLATOR/Intl.Collator path and switched the builder to a strict code-unit comparator for deterministic byte-order sorting.
Fixed in 3eec58395: compareByteOrder now uses strict < / > code-unit comparison on normalized strings, removing locale-sensitive behavior from all builder sort paths.

Fixed in 3eec58395: validator now emits a single input_artifacts_valid check that aggregates missing source artifacts and input diagnostics, with diagnostics sorted by code/role/path; missing and malformed reads use artifact_missing/artifact_malformed.
Fixed in 3eec58395: added regression tests for missing and malformed query-surface inputs, asserting fail status, input_artifacts_valid failure, and artifact_missing/artifact_malformed diagnostics.
